clinical_intent: I need to understand how to handle MRI artifacts in brachytherapy planning. What types of MRI artifacts can affect brachytherapy planning (susceptibility artifacts from metallic applicators, chemical shift artifacts, motion artifacts)? How do these artifacts affect target and applicator delineation? What correction methods exist? How should I adjust the MRI protocol to minimize artifacts?
